games.quickSummary: Simple action style game. Where you play as Dummy and try to kill the enemies on the desert land
games.description: UE5 begginers project. The project was focused on creating a 3rd person action style game with popular core features. Like multiple weapons, currencies and enemies. The game uses provided and downloaded asssets from Mixamo (skins and animations) incorporated with C++ code and BPs alike.
games.learning: The key things that I got from this were how to use the C++ framework to create Base classes to them use them as BPs. How Animations (AnimMontages, AnimBPs, ThreadSafe, Notifys) work and make the game feel realistic. And something that I enjoyed was leveling(making the level) for landscaping and prototyping with the modeling tool and basic shapes, it does help a lot to have the basic structure of the map while testing features.
games.keyFeatures: The game contains multiple movesets for each weapon type. Following the more common action style games.

games.quickSummary: Simple mechanic game to play online using GAS
games.description: Introductory project to GAS. Using mainly Paragon assets to learn how does GAS work. The game is a third person moba style game. Using the character Bear from the Fab and assigning 2 abilities(GameplayAbilities) and 2 enemies that can take and do damage. The enemies are melee and range type. Each with the same basic abilities but different usage for both to fit the type of attack better.
games.learning: It is quite interesting (from a programmer standpoint) how GAS makes some of the work easier. Using the abilities and effects from the system makes pretty simple to use replication to get a good base online experience. Of course that even on a basic level it depends on how it is managed(the montage playing, the replication type, how events are handled and validated) it does provides a goodo entry point to make an online game.

games.quickSummary: Pick and deliver icecream to the hungry neighbors.
games.description: Begginers project to learn Unity editor. The objective of the game is to drive around a small neighborhood picking up packages and deliver them to the right monsters. You can get speed boosters along the road, however if you bump into the fences or the trees your speed will drop back, try and optimize the route to deliver faster!
games.learning: Given that this is the very first time that I jump into Unity, everything was new and a learning oportunity, however since I have been using UE for some time now it was faster to pick up the pace and understanding conceps. Using sprites does feel different than laying 3D objects it can get really messy though if you don't use a proper order for them. Collisions and Triggers have certain similarity to UE to it was easy to understand how to use them. The same with the base methods for a class(Start & Update that work like BeginPlay and Tick) overall. Unity for 2D development is really interesting and I'll be looking to learn the editor and C# better.

games.quickSummary: Try and reach the goal whithout slipping or falling.
games.description: 2D game where you to have to keep balance and reach the goal flag at the end of a mountain. This short game focuses on keeping balance while moving in a single direction picking up buffs and secrets
games.learning: Adjusting different type of collisions to a forced impulsed object can be interesting, since it can make some bugs happen depending on the speed. Alse, using multiple amount of shape collision to achive different behaviors is really practical, but can be a little misleading when they interact

games.quickSummary: Move down through the levels of the unkonwn while collection as much gold as posible
games.description: This small MetroidVania inspired game focuses on simple platforming with some popular mechanics, like jumping, swimmming and ladder climbing. You will encounter some enemies along the way. You can either shoot them or just leave them be. The objective is to traverse across while pickiing the coins and reach the next level.
games.learning: The game contains multiple levels and the amount of money you collect will persist across them. Of course the player has health that if it reaches 0 you will die and have to start over. The higher the score the better, which mean you will have to collect all coins sppread accross the levels even some hidden or in dangerours places. Some of the assets(sprites) where provided and others like SFX just grabbed from the internet.

games.quickSummary: Destroy all enemies ships and be the last one flying
games.description: Shoot 'Em Up inspired game where you fight waves of enemies that will try to destroy you. Dodging and shooting is the way to destroy the most enemies and survive.
games.learning: This game is a POC based on old arcade games, although the variety of enemies and patters is not that big, the objective was to create something that could serve as a ground work for a bigger game. This means that the waves where made so that different enemy types can be used as well the amount of enemies. There is no level progression is focused on survival, since its more of a infinite game.

games.quickSummary: Venture into different places to find a way out this strange planet.
games.description: In this side scrolling game you control a small space ship that needs to venture throug some tight spaces to be able to leave this new space planet. While thrusting up and keeping balance you have to dodge the different obstacles before reaching the next landing zone.

games.quickSummary: See how far can you run while dodging what the world throws at you.
games.description: Try to collect as much money as possible without getting hit by the obstacles. In this small infinite runnner game you play as a king that is always trying to get more time to earn more money.
games.learning: The game uses procedural generation to create an infinite space the player runs and tries to collect as much money as possible. To add some challenge the player must avoid the different obstacles that exist on the run, such as shor trip walls on the floor and random type of objects that spawned at the end. Every certain while a small banner will appear that will increase the timer. The apples will make the player faster to recover or inscrease the running speed. Try and keep bigger score each time, but don't get hit too much. Seeing infront will become more tuff as you get hit.

games.quickSummary: Destroy all enemies in the room to secure victory.
games.description: Simple FPS where you have to destroy all the enemies in the run to win and live. Get some ammo and test all weapons to find that one that suits you better and destroy all robots.
games.learning: ShooterBox is a FPS POC to try and get some knowledge on shooters using Unity. It has common features like multiple weapons and each with different stats (damage, fire rate, magazine, auto) and a couple type of enemies that move and stay still. Of course the enemies need to be taken down to be able to win the game however if you don't keep up with them, they will keep spawning and overwhelm you with sheer amount. Altough there is only 1 level the objetive was to test the features and keep track for future projects to use it as reference.

games.quickSummary: Jump and fly your way out, if you can.
games.description: Small prototype based on the game Geometry Dash(GD) by RobTopGames. This game has the basic mechanics from GD applied to a 3D environment, it contains 3 levels to test how well can those mechanics be applied to mevment and jump, which means you can change the direction the movement is being applied from and create obstacles in a new way. Since the original game has complexity in its simplicity it was important to keep that feeling just adding a simple way the Cube can interact with a 3D world without loosing the feeling of focusing on the simple platforming.
games.learning: To be able to make the Player feel that the game keeps the core gameplay but with new additions, the 1st level is a part of the original game, to create a sensation and rhythm with the world, talking about the jumping, speed and distances. The 2nd level is almost the exact same obstacle layout but 3D, some movement to left, right and forward keeping the wolrd values so that the player doesn't loose the pacing from the previous level. The 3rd level is a different concept, a small maze where you can not touch the walls but must find a way out.
knownIssues: The space bar, Jumping button, doesn't reaact inmmediatly in some computers
The shaders don't work properly in some Windows 11 PCs.

games.quickSummary: Find and collect al the data within the box.
games.description: Top down shooter game where you have to find the data packages spread around while destroying or avoiding the enemies inside the box. The game controls are based on classic asteroid where you con move anywhere while aiming in 360 Deg.
games.learning: This small game objective was to try and test some new mechanics in Unity. The main one was how to use destructible objects and how to mix 3D with 2D (Which was really straight forward). Another one was to create small AI movement and behavior from code only that make the game and enemies feel intelligent within their boundaries. Lastly, into more personal note, different ways to delegate tasks per scripts (higher type of segregation abstraction). And test how much can I script do without having a ton of separated scripts per object and how does this impact both performance and memory management.
knownIssues: The objective UI dissapears when picking certain objects or in certain order.
Not exactly and issue. But the way the borders interact with different objects is too scatered. This needs rework.
The background doesnt work as intented.
